alternative.src/positions.mjs: const read=k=>{const [n,d]=k.split('/').map(BigInt);return [n,d];};const key=(n,d)=>{let a=n<0n?-n:n,b=d;while(b){[a,b]=[b,a%b];}return (n/a)+'/'+(d/a);};export function compare(a,b){const [an,ad]=read(a),[bn,bd]=read(b),x=an*bd-bn*ad;return x<0n?-1:x>0n?1:0;}export function between(left,right){if(left===null&&right===null)return '0/1';if(left===null){const [n,d]=read(right);return key(n-d,d);}if(right===null){const [n,d]=read(left);return key(n+d,d);}if(compare(left,right)>=0)throw new RangeError('order');const [a,b]=read(left),[c,d]=read(right);const common=b*d;const leftUnits=a*d,rightUnits=c*b;return key(leftUnits+rightUnits,common*2n);}export function rebalance(items){const sorted=[...items];sorted.sort((a,b)=>{const c=compare(a.key,b.key);return c||((a.id>b.id)-(a.id<b.id));});const out=[];for(let i=0;i<sorted.length;i++)out.push({id:sorted[i].id,key:i+'/1',label:sorted[i].label});return out;}
